source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_37/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_37/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_37/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_37/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_37_3 and Source3_37_0 on County
df = pd.merge(source3, source0, on="County", how="inner")

# Join the result with Source3_37_1 on County
df = pd.merge(df, source1, on="County", how="inner")

# Join the result with Source3_37_2 on County
df = pd.merge(df, source2, on="County", how="inner")

# Group by County to ensure uniqueness and remove duplicates if any
df = df.groupby("County", as_index=False).first()

# Select only the columns in the target schema: ['County', 'r1401', 'r1403']
df = df[["County", "r1401", "r1403"]]

# Write the final output
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_37/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
